entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: A collection of artifacts and beings assembled by Urza to defeat Yawgmoth, a construct of thought given purpose.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who assembled the Legacy; dies activating it.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Urza's mortal enemy, destroyed by the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Champion destined to be part of the Legacy; dies in its activation.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Gerrard's adopted brother who stole Legacy artifacts to thwart Gerrard's destiny.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Stole the Touchstone as an example of Gerrard's possessions.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who is part of the Legacy, deactivated with the Touchstone and later infused with Urza's spark.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Guardian of the Weatherlight who found several Legacy pieces before being abducted.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who realizes Gerrard's connection to the Legacy.

entities.name: Meida
entities.description: First mate who dies in the scuffle for the Juju Bubble.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Crew member the Weatherlight re-recruits in Llanowar.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard adept who joins the crew and activates the Chimeric Sphere.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Crew member who tests Ertai on the Chimeric Sphere and Mind Stone.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Crew member who helps strike a deal in Mercadia.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Entrusted with the Skyshaper and other pieces, but lets Karn take the Legacy.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship of the Weatherlight crew, reshaped by the Thran Tome.

entities.name: Touchstone
entities.description: A Legacy artifact used to deactivate Karn and an aboroth.

entities.name: Juju Bubble
entities.description: A Legacy artifact found in the Adarkar Wastes.

entities.name: Thran Forge
entities.description: A Legacy artifact used to turn an aboroth into an artificial creature.

entities.name: Chimeric Sphere
entities.description: A Legacy artifact that Ertai activates against a fog elemental.

entities.name: Mind Stone
entities.description: A Legacy artifact found by Sisay.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: Urza's construction documentation, consumed by Karn.

entities.name: Skyshaper
entities.description: A Legacy artifact taken by Volrath and later entrusted to the Sliver Queen.

entities.name: Bones of Ramos
entities.description: Ramos's body parts gifted to the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Hourglass
entities.description: A Legacy artifact worn by Gerrard, left in Benalia.

entities.name: Null Rod
entities.description: A Legacy object of unclear operation that remained with Gerrard.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: A Legacy piece the women of the crew negotiate for at Saprazzo.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: Stored white mana source whose use failed to stop the Black Cloud of Death.

entities.name: Adarkar Wastes
entities.description: Place where Sisay and Tahngarth located the Juju Bubble.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Where Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested.

entities.name: Weatherlight Saga
entities.description: The saga in which the Legacy is assembled.

events.summary: Volrath steals many of Gerrard's original artifacts to thwart his destiny; the Touchstone is the first lost.
events.quote: stolen by his adopted brother Volrath

events.summary: In 4195 AR Sisay and Tahngarth find the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; a war beast attacks and first mate Meida dies.
events.quote: though first mate Meida lost her life in the scuffle.

events.summary: The Touchstone is used to deactivate Karn, who stands as a statue for 11 years before the crew picks him up in 4204 AR.
events.quote: Karn stood as a statue for 11 years

events.summary: Gerrard reactivates Karn and takes the Touchstone from his hand.
events.quote: Gerrard then found a way to reactivate Karn and plucked the Touchstone from his opening grasp.

events.summary: In Llanowar Gerrard uses the Thran Forge and Touchstone to turn an aboroth into dust, showing Tahngarth his connection to the Legacy.
events.quote: This is what made Tahngarth realize the special connection Gerrard had with the Legacy artifacts.

events.summary: Ertai, tested on the Chimeric Sphere, activates it against a fog elemental, which destroys it.
events.quote: Ertai ended his abeyance spell and activated the sphere

events.summary: In Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath; Karn gets them from the Sliver Queen.
events.quote: the Queen let Karn take the Legacy from her.

events.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
events.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

events.summary: The Null Moon plan fails; Urza reveals the final secret and the Legacy Weapon is fired using Urza's stones, Karn's body and Gerrard's life, killing Urza and Gerrard and destroying Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza and Gerrard died in the activation, but the weapon successfully destroyed Yawgmoth.

events.summary: Karn, infused with Urza's spark, takes up his former master's staff and leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: took up his former master's staff and soon left Dominaria.

relations.note: Assembled the Legacy to defeat Yawgmoth.
relations.quote: The Legacy was a collection of artifacts assembled by Urza
took up his former master's staff
